The mic is haunted. 🎃🎤 Drag-O-Ween Karaoke crashes the Lounge with Beah Hazard hosting a full Halloween takeover — think fog, face paint, and every scream-along anthem you've got in you. Come in costume because best dressed doesn't just win bragging rights, it wins two tickets to an upcoming show. Free entry means zero excuses. Grab your group, grab your gore, and get ready to turn the Lounge into the most unhinged karaoke night Pasco's seen all October. 🖤👻

📅 Wednesday, October 14 — 7PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free Entry

Fog curling off the floor, face paint catching the lights, a mic that's seen things. 🖤🎃 Drag-O-Ween Karaoke isn't background noise — it's the whole vibe. Beah Hazard keeps the Lounge humming while costumed queens and freaks alike take turns owning the spotlight. Every chorus hits different when half the room's in full Halloween drag. The energy builds, the fog thickens, the night gets weirder in the best way. This is the kind of Wednesday you don't scroll past. 🕸️🎤

An event put on by queens, for everyone. 💅🎃 Drag-O-Ween Karaoke is built for whoever you want to come as — zombie, clown, icon, yourself in a cape. Beah Hazard's hosting the Lounge all night, and there's no wrong way to show up as long as you're ready to sing, scream, or just vibe with the costumes around you. Best dressed walks away with two tickets to an upcoming show, but honestly everyone wins just by being in the room for this one. Come as you are, come as you dream — just come. 🖤👑

Mark it down: Drag-O-Ween Karaoke hits the Lounge Wednesday, October 14th at 7PM. 📋🎃 Beah Hazard hosts the whole night, costumes are encouraged (best one wins two tickets to an upcoming show), and entry is completely free. No ticket, no cover, just show up ready to sing and ready to dress the part. Bring your friends, bring your worst Halloween pun, bring your best costume — this is the easiest free night out Pasco's got this month. 🎤👻
